backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining data types and storage maps for user profiles, fasting schedules, nutrition, sleep, movement, and stress entries, plus admin-controlled ICP payment address and user activation management with role-based access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report linking the admin ICP wallet configuration panel feature to its implementing files (PaymentGate.tsx and useActivationQueries.ts) with high confidence.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: JSON dictionary of short summaries for each frontend source file, describing the purpose and recent changes of components, hooks, pages, and configuration files.
frontend/index.css: Global Tailwind CSS entry point defining OKLCH-based design tokens for light and dark themes including colors for backgrounds, borders, charts, and sidebar elements.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the LivSpan app that forces dark mode on load via an inline script to prevent a light-mode flash before React mounts.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component that gates rendering based on authentication and activation state, showing a loading screen, PaymentGate for unactivated users, or the full StartDashboard for activated users.
frontend/src/components/auth/LoginButton: Button component handling Internet Identity login and logout with loading state, query cache clearing on logout, and styled gradient appearance.
frontend/src/components/auth/PaymentGate: Payment gate screen shown to authenticated but unactivated users, displaying the ICP payment address with copy functionality and an admin-only inline panel to view and update the wallet address.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Factor: Interactive health factor card component with green-blue gradient backgrounds, radial overlays, and scale/shadow animations for selected and hover states.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Fastin: A settings card component that allows authenticated users to view and edit their intermittent fasting schedule (start/end hours), displaying the calculated fasting/eating duration and persisting changes via a save mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Interm: A dashboard panel that displays the user's current fasting phase, a live countdown timer, and progress bar based on their saved fasting schedule, and embeds the FastingScheduleSettings component for authenticated users.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Moveme: A dashboard panel for logging daily physical activity, providing selectors for activity type (walk/run/bike/gym), intensity level, and active minutes, with save/load functionality tied to today's date.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Nutrit: A dashboard panel for tracking daily nutrition metrics including calories, protein, and water intake, with BMI and protein target calculations derived from the user's profile and fasting window state.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/SleepP: A dashboard panel for logging daily sleep duration and quality score using gradient sliders, displaying progress toward an 8-hour goal and persisting entries via a save mutation.
frontend/src/components/dashboard/Stress: Dashboard panel for logging daily blood pressure and pulse data, with numeric input fields, a visual BP/pulse display, and save functionality via React Query mutations.
frontend/src/components/genome/AnimatedH: SVG-based animated DNA double helix background component with gradient strands, connecting base pairs, and glow filters using CSS animations.
frontend/src/components/genome/HelixSpin: Layout wrapper that renders an SVG DNA helix spine with animated strands and base pairs as a decorative background behind vertically spaced child elements.
frontend/src/components/i18n/LanguageSwi: Button component that toggles the app language between English and German, highlighting the active language using the i18n context.
frontend/src/components/profile/ProfileO: Gate component that shows a login prompt for unauthenticated users or a profile-setup modal for authenticated users without a profile, before rendering children.
frontend/src/hooks/queryKeys.ts: Centralized definition of React Query cache keys for all data domains including user profile, fasting, nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, activation, and ICP address.
React Query hooks for checking user activation status (polling every 30s), fetching the ICP payment address, checking admin status, and setting the ICP address.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor via React Query, invalidating dependent queries whenever the identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingScheduleQue: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's fasting schedule, with toast notifications on success or error.
frontend/src/hooks/useFastingWindowTimer: React hook that calculates the current fasting/eating phase, elapsed time, remaining time, and progress percentage based on a configurable schedule, updating every second.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication on the ICP platform, managing login/logout state, identity persistence, and AuthClient lifecycle.
frontend/src/hooks/useMovementQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's daily movement entry via the backend actor, keyed by date string.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's nutrition entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useSleepQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving today's sleep entry for the authenticated user via the backend actor.
frontend/src/hooks/useStressQueries.ts: React Query hooks for fetching and saving a user's daily stress entry via the backend actor, keyed by date string.
frontend/src/hooks/useUserProfileQueries: React Query hooks for fetching and saving the current user's profile via the backend actor, with actor-dependent loading state to prevent UI flashes.
frontend/src/i18n/LanguageProvider.tsx: React context provider that manages the active language (English or German), persisting the selection to localStorage and defaulting to the browser's language.
frontend/src/i18n/translations.ts: Defines TypeScript interfaces and translation objects for English and German UI strings covering all app sections including auth, nutrition, sleep, fasting, and more.
frontend/src/i18n/useI18n.ts: Simple hook that retrieves the LanguageContext value, throwing an error if used outside of a LanguageProvider.
frontend/src/index.css: Global CSS file that sets up Tailwind directives and defines a comprehensive OKLCH-based design token system for light and dark modes, including colors, gradients, and helix-themed palette variables.
frontend/src/lib/fastingMetrics.ts: Empty file placeholder for fasting metrics utility functions.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionCalculations.t: Pure client-side helper functions for nutrition calculations including BMI, protein targets, progress percentages, and water intake tracking.
frontend/src/lib/nutritionGuidance.ts: Analyzes macro nutrient distribution (calories, protein, fat, carbs) and returns a deterministic guidance key for i18n lookup based on thresholds like low/high protein or calorie mismatches.
frontend/src/lib/timeFormat.ts: Shared utility functions for formatting time durations into HH:MM:SS strings and hours with one decimal place.
frontend/src/lib/utils.ts: Exports a single `cn` utility that merges Tailwind class names using clsx and tailwind-merge.
frontend/src/main.tsx: React app entry point that wraps the App component with React Query and Internet Identity authentication providers.
frontend/src/pages/StartDashboard.tsx: Main dashboard page rendering a DNA helix background with animated layers, a header with login/language controls, and interactive health factor panels (nutrition, sleep, movement, stress, fasting) along a helix spine.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility functions for extracting, persisting, and clearing URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage fallback support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration extending the theme with OKLCH/HSL design tokens, custom helix and sage/teal color palettes, font families, and keyframe animations for helix breathing and glow effects.
project_state.json: Project state metadata for LivSpan tracking existing features and pending feature requests, including an admin ICP payment address configuration panel and backend payment address management function.
